description: Agent Automotive: submit a vehicle title as printed with the title or ownership record: the title with its issuer, title number, VIN, each owner name as printed, the lienholder, the title brand (clean, salvage, rebuilt, flood or junk) and the day issued; the record with its issuer, title number, VIN, each owner of record, the lienholder, the lien status (none, active or released) with the day released, the brand of record and the day it was read. The signed report gives the title and the record, the VIN on each side, the owners printed and of record with those unrecorded or left off, the lien printed against the lien of record, and the brand printed against the brand of record, and counts them, and names a discrepant title: a VIN unlike the record, an owner printed that the record does not hold or an owner of record left off, an active lien of record the title leaves off, another lienholder, and a brand unlike the record, such as a clean title where the record shows salvage, rebuilt, flood or junk; then a lienholder the record does not show, a lienholder printed after the record shows the lien released, another title number and another issuer wording, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No VIN or no owner on either side, a record with no lien status and no lienholder, or no brand on either side leaves the title unverified. Owner names match without case, spacing or punctuation and in either order when written last name first, each side read as a set. This reads a vehicle title against its title record, identified by VIN: wever_realty-title-check reads a property title and ownership record against the transaction it is read for, by parcel and address, and wever_tokenized-custody-check reads who holds a tokenized asset’s underlying asset, not who owns a vehicle. Verdict auto_title_discrepant, auto_title_partial, auto_title_unverified or auto_title_matched. POST /api/auto-title-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
